response.courseDescription: 311 Viticulture I Fall viticulture theory and practices including identification and utilization of rootstocks, wine grapes, and wild species; grape species taxonomy and diversity; breeding efforts for grapevine improvement and clean plant material.
response.coursePrerequisites: BIOLOGY 106 or 120; SOIL SCI 201; VIT ENOL 113; VIT ENOL 280.
